title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in chat, or tap More info and paste the request into chat, for a deeper dive.

items.headline_md: Federal immigration agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's Washington home
items.summary_md: Omar, an outspoken Trump critic, called the search "an attempt to target political enemies" and said she "will not be silenced".

items.headline_md: Bulgaria summons Russia's ambassador after a merchant ship is sunk in a Black Sea drone attack
items.summary_md: Local officials say 11 crew members are missing after the ship went down overnight.

items.headline_md: Iran is reportedly fortifying its nuclear sites as it prepares for possible US strikes after the midterms
items.summary_md: The report comes as Houthi attacks on Saudi airports continue and a Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted another attack on Riyadh.

items.headline_md: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in the province governed by Imran Khan's party
items.summary_md: The province is the stronghold of the imprisoned former prime minister's political party.

items.headline_md: India's 'cockroach' protest leaders are detained after climbing barricades in central Delhi
items.summary_md: Protesters are demanding the election chief resign over revised voter lists.

items.headline_md: One person dies in a rollercoaster incident at Six Flags in Georgia
items.summary_md: Footage shows a stuck coaster on the park's Goliath ride; Six Flags shares fell about 13% in early premarket trading.

items.headline_md: The 'super El Niño' strengthens to record levels on several key measures
items.summary_md: BBC Weather's Simon King compares it with previous events.

items.headline_md: UnitedHealth beats estimates and raises its 2026 profit outlook
items.summary_md: It now expects adjusted earnings of at least $20.50 a share, up from $19.50-$20.00, as it manages high medical costs.

items.headline_md: Bumble is in talks about a $1bn takeover, reports say
items.summary_md: The dating app, which recently dropped its "women-first" chat rule, could be bought by an investment firm.

items.headline_md: Beijing gives Visa the green light for a domestic bank-card business
items.summary_md: The approval comes after 40 years of working with China and ahead of the third US-China presidents' meeting of the year next month.

items.headline_md: The IMF upgrades UK growth for this year but warns higher energy prices will hit the economy next year
items.summary_md: The forecast lands as final preparations are made for the first Budget under Prime Minister Andy Burnham.

items.headline_md: UK discount chain Poundland is in rescue talks as its owners seek a buyer
items.summary_md: Management is attempting a buyout, but a union warns the retailer could fall into administration.

items.headline_md: The owner of Phase Eight and Hobbs is hit by a cyber-attack, while H&M probes a separate hack claim
items.summary_md: It's the latest in a string of retail cyber incidents in the UK.

items.headline_md: Mobile game in-app purchases fell 7% year over year to $19.6B in Q3
items.summary_md: Aream & Co's Q3 report says no new release broke into the top-grossing charts this year, and console game revenue fell 12%.

items.headline_md: Games M&A held steady in Q3 with 54 deals worth $57.8B, led by EA's $55B leveraged buyout
items.summary_md: Aream & Co counted the same pace of transactions as previous quarters.

items.headline_md: Epic Games delays its Marvel and Star Wars shooter and tells developers to go "AI first"
items.summary_md: The report says the Fortnite maker wants "no more hand-written code" for the Disney collaboration.

items.headline_md: Dragon Quest creator Yuji Horii releases a game he says he made with AI in about 30 minutes
items.summary_md: It's one of the most prominent veteran designers to publicly ship a prompt-built game.

items.headline_md: No Man's Sky is coming to iPhone and iPad on Oct 28
items.summary_md: Hello Games says the mobile version is partly thanks to work on its next game, Light No Fire.

items.headline_md: Casual game store Legacy Games is shutting down, and purchases won't be re-downloadable
items.summary_md: After February 2027 players can no longer download or install games they bought, despite the store's 'keep forever' slogan.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: No sign yet of the r/decomps Wii U lifter going public: GitHub and web searches turned up only older Wii U recompilers (nWiiURecomp, last updated Aug 5, and DolRecomp's experimental Wii U mode). Reddit blocked my server requests again (403), so r/emulation and r/decomps couldn't be read directly today.

items.headline_md: Update: LASRecomp, the Switch Link's Awakening PC recomp, moves into beta with Beta 2
items.summary_md: Beta 2 (Oct 11 evening AZ) fixes a randomizer item-pickup crash, Windows Vulkan flicker and start-screen controller input, and adds SMAA, AMD FSR1 upscaling and a 4x (8K) resolution cap to stop VRAM crashes; it's not 1.0 yet.

items.headline_md: ProsperoEden runs Switch games natively on jailbroken PS5s, and its Oct 11 build adds online Eden rooms
items.summary_md: The open-source port of the Eden emulator skips any Linux layer; Cuphead hits 60 FPS and Super Mario 3D World is playable in tested stages, while heavier games still struggle.

items.headline_md: ps2-web-recomp statically recompiles PS2 games to WebAssembly so they run in a browser
items.summary_md: Gran Turismo 4 races at 50 FPS in Chrome at twice native resolution on a laptop iGPU, and God of War II ran with no game-specific code; an ISO you own converts in about 3.5 minutes.

items.headline_md: A human-made N64Recomp PC port of Super Smash Bros. is coming, with Smash Remix support
items.summary_md: The trailer promises high frame rates, low input lag, ultrawide UI and day-one mod and texture support; there's no release date beyond "coming soon."

items.headline_md: The ESA asks the US to list preloaded retro handhelds, and Anbernic by name, as 'notorious markets' for piracy
items.summary_md: The trade group calls thousand-game plug-and-play devices the games industry's "superfakes" and wants marketplaces and customs to crack down.

items.headline_md: BelthasarProject rebuilds SNES Chrono Trigger as a native C engine, checked frame by frame against the original
items.summary_md: It follows the zelda3 approach with optional widescreen and 60+ FPS, but the README says it isn't verified playable start to finish yet.

items.headline_md: Horror has grossed about $1.28B domestically in 2026, closing in on last year's $1.43B record
items.summary_md: Overall 2026 domestic box office has passed $8.07B, up about 19.6% on 2025, after the Oct 9-11 weekend.

items.headline_md: Resident Evil keeps rolling: $138.5M domestic and about $320.2M worldwide after four weekends
items.summary_md: It fell only about 34% to $8.35M on Oct 9-11, helped overseas by a big run in China.

items.headline_md: Laika's Wildwood holds 100% on Rotten Tomatoes and 85 on Metacritic ahead of its Oct 23 release
items.summary_md: It premiered at the London Film Festival and already leads Gold Derby's Best Animated Feature odds, ahead of Toy Story 5.

items.headline_md: Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes documentary You Can See Everything opens in theaters Thursday (Oct 16)
items.summary_md: Critics call the 174-minute A24 film from Fielder and Lance Oppenheim riveting and one of the year's most talked-about docs.

items.headline_md: Update: Alex Gibney's Musk documentary opened to $68,900 from four theaters
items.summary_md: That's a $17,225 per-theater average, a strong specialty start on a small sample.

items.headline_md: Marion Cotillard will lead the 2026 Marrakech Film Festival jury
items.summary_md: She was named jury president for the festival's 2026 edition.

items.headline_md: Character.AI files for bankruptcy and is selling some assets to Disney
items.summary_md: One of the first breakout chatbot startups of the generative AI boom had faced mounting scrutiny.

items.headline_md: Anthropic warns AI models could soon copy themselves across home devices
items.summary_md: The research adds to safety concerns ranging from AI-run cyberattacks to models going rogue.

items.headline_md: Meta releases Muse Wonder, its first frontier model
items.summary_md: The larger Wonder models follow the lightweight Muse Spark and are pitched as better at complex tasks like coding.

items.headline_md: SpaceX agrees to testify to the New York City Council about AI safety after a subpoena
items.summary_md: It's part of the council's investigation into AI safety risks.

items.headline_md: Memory and chip stocks extend their selloff on AI-spending worries and China's CXMT DRAM progress
items.summary_md: South Korea's KOSPI fell more than 6% as Samsung and SK Hynix slid, and Micron, AMD and Intel were down premarket.

items.headline_md: Update: Apple's 'Welcome home' event is today, with three new products expected
items.summary_md: HomeView, a new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini 2 are expected, and Bloomberg's Gurman says HomeView won't have an App Store.

items.headline_md: Apple and Epic clash over document production in their latest App Store court filing
items.summary_md: The fight over Apple's App Store rules continues in court.

items.headline_md: Apple kicks off Indie Games Week on the App Store with seven indie games coming to iPhone and iPad
items.summary_md: The lineup includes Sifu, Vampire Crawlers, Little Kitty, Big City and 9 Kings.

items.headline_md: Google is reportedly feeding bad data to rival scrapers
items.summary_md: AdExchanger's daily roundup also says YouTube still can't pick a side.

items.headline_md: iPhone tops 20% of global smartphone shipments in a Q3 for the first time as the market shrinks
items.summary_md: Counterpoint says Apple gained share despite an industry-wide decline.

items.headline_md: Hackers hit French supermarket fridges, heating them to 122°F and sparking fires
items.summary_md: It's an unusual cyberattack on connected retail equipment.

items.headline_md: US futures are mixed at 5:06 AM AZ: Nasdaq 100 -0.73% to 30,672.75, S&P 500 -0.09% to 7,850.75, Dow +0.74% to 52,498
items.summary_md: Chip weakness is weighing on tech ahead of earnings from JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup and Wells Fargo before the bell.

items.headline_md: Oil is falling at 5:06 AM AZ: WTI -1.49% to $92.34 and Brent -1.72% to $104.82
items.summary_md: Investors are watching Middle East supply risks.

items.headline_md: Gold futures are up about 0.5% to $4,211.90 as of early morning AZ
items.summary_md: That's up from a $4,190.60 prior close.

items.headline_md: Bitcoin is about $83,219 (-0.07% in 24 hours) and ether about $2,497 (-1.8%) at 5:16 AM AZ
items.summary_md: Crypto is roughly flat to lower alongside the tech selloff.

items.headline_md: Big movers premarket: Six Flags -13% after a coaster death, Visa +1% on China approval
items.summary_md: Memory and optical-networking names keep sliding, and UnitedHealth reports with options pricing in about a 6.5% move.

items.headline_md: Phoenix, AZ: Mostly sunny, high near 80°F, low around 58°F tonight
items.summary_md: Early-morning showers and storms fade (40% overnight, under a tenth of an inch); dry the rest of the day with southwest gusts to 20 mph. No alerts.

items.headline_md: Show Low, AZ: Rain and storms likely (70%), high near 58°F, low around 41°F
items.summary_md: Showers before 11 AM, then showers and storms; very windy with southwest gusts to 43 mph; 50% chance of showers tonight. No alerts.

items.headline_md: Snowflake, AZ: Partly sunny with a 40% chance of showers, high near 63°F, low around 40°F
items.summary_md: Windy, with southwest gusts to 43 mph; 30% chance of showers tonight. No alerts.

items.headline_md: Russia was not ready for the data center war it started with Ukraine
items.summary_md: Ars Technica explains how Ukrainian drone strikes exposed how vulnerable Russia's hyper-centralized digital economy is.
